turns.assistant: The plugin was built with rustc 1.78 and the host with 1.81. Rust has no stable ABI, so struct layout of the Plugin trait object differs; dlopen then calls through a wrong vtable. Plugins must be built with the exact toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml, or expose a C ABI.
